12,480 drawings for Svelte: 2,496 symbols, each in outline, twotone, bold, bulk and broken. The same artwork as [`@devigner-ui/icons`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@devigner-ui/icons), rendered from it rather than redrawn, so the two cannot drift.

```bash
pnpm add @devigner-ui/icons-svelte
```

Works with Svelte 4 and Svelte 5.

## Why Devigner Icons

Two open icon sets, merged, deduplicated and consistently named, then built for
every framework below from one set of artwork. One design language, wherever
you work.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devigner-ui/icons@main/.github/assets/features-dark.svg" />
  <img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devigner-ui/icons@main/.github/assets/features-light.svg" width="100%" alt="12,480 drawings: 2,496 symbols on one 24×24 grid, every one free. Five styles each: outline, twotone, bold, bulk and broken. Every framework: React, Vue, Svelte, SolidJS, Angular, Nuxt, React Native, JavaScript, Flutter, Rails, Blazor and SVG. Search by meaning: one 384-dim vector per symbol ships as embeddings.json. TypeScript first: every symbol is a typed named export. Tree shakeable: sideEffects false, ship only what you import. No runtime dependencies: React 18 or later as a peer." />
</picture>

React needs 18+ and ships the `icons` CLI. Svelte covers 4 and 5, React Native
covers Expo, and Angular needs 16+. The Nuxt module auto-imports the Vue
package. Plain JavaScript gets SVG strings and elements, and the SVG package
covers everything else: CDN links, CSS and templates. The MCP server lets AI
coding tools search the set.

## Use

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconAdd, IconShoppingCart } from "@devigner-ui/icons-svelte";
</script>

<IconAdd class="size-6" />
<IconShoppingCart variant="bulk" class="size-6 text-violet-600" />
```

Every icon is one component file, so a bundler keeps only what you import.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"outline" \| "twotone" \| "bold" \| "bulk" \| "broken"` | `"outline"` | Which drawing to render. Every icon has all five. |
| `strokeWidth` | `string \| number` | `1.5` | Stroke width, in the drawing's own units. Outline, twotone and broken; bold and bulk keep their own weight. |

Everything else (`class`, `style`, `id`, `on:click`, `data-*`, the aria attributes) falls through to the `<svg>`.

Strokes and fills are `currentColor`, so size and colour come from CSS:

```svelte
<IconAdd class="size-5 text-slate-500" />
```

## Accessibility

Icons are decorative by default: they render `aria-hidden="true"`, because an icon sitting beside its own text label is otherwise read out twice. Naming one promotes it to an image:

```svelte
<IconAdd aria-label="Add item" />
```

## Source, not a bundle

The package ships `.svelte` files, which your own toolchain compiles, the normal shape for a Svelte library, and the reason there is no build here for you to configure.

## Community & contributing

- Browse, search and copy every icon at [icons.devigner.cc](https://icons.devigner.cc)
- Request an icon, or vote on what gets drawn next, on the [requests board](https://icons.devigner.cc/requests/)
- Report a bug with the bug button on any icon's page, or [open a bug report](https://github.com/devigner-ui/icons/issues/new?template=bug.yml)
- Ask a question or share an idea on [Discord](https://discord.gg/PSv2aFYhuC)
